Character reference only: Abdul's face, hair, beard, pale blue rolled-sleeve shirt, navy pants, brown shoes, and pixel-art style from the input. Disregard the reference running poses. Draw a NEW running cycle from scratch.

Use a strict SIDE VIEW of the body with a slight three-quarter face, and fixed hips and ground origin. Crisp 16-bit sprite art, no words, no scenery, no floor, no grids.

Make the two legs unmistakable with consistent directional shading: the NEAR leg is STEEL BLUE (#425675) with bright blue highlights; the FAR leg is VERY DARK NAVY (#151e32). These are the two sides of his navy trousers. Keep this color assignment attached to the SAME leg in every pose. Never change which leg is lighter. At frame 2: LIGHT near leg points DOWN under the hips and bears weight; DARK far leg folds behind with heel curled UP on the LEFT.

At frame 6: LIGHT near knee lifts HIGH forward RIGHT in FRONT of the pelvis, near heel tucked beneath the raised knee; DARK far leg extends back LEFT for push-off. Then the light knee unfolds into frame 1.
Arms counter-swing naturally: light near leg FORWARD means near arm BACK; light near leg BACK means near arm FORWARD. Head ALWAYS faces RIGHT.

Critical visual test: the LIGHT foreground leg points RIGHT in frame 1, DOWN in frame 2, LEFT in frames 3 and 4, curls BACK in frame 5, and raises its knee RIGHT in frame 6. This exact order is mandatory. Frame 3 is a dark knee raised, frame 6 is a light knee raised. No repeated first-half poses in the second half. Frame 1 and frame 4 have different foreground silhouettes.

All six equally sized and equally spaced. Genuine transparent PNG alpha, generous margins around the sprites. No extra limbs, no blur.
